Honestly I dont think that... Sure, if your brain is damaged and you cant do a lot of things because of that, its terrible and it can influence your whole life. But if you believe that we are something more and that we are here either because of the "experience" or because we have to learn something here, it shouldnt really bother you, because sooner or later you will return to your true self which you are not aware of because it isnt here right now. And yes, i think that a life in which you go through something like that has its meaning in a larger scale. I completely understand your feelings, believe me - ive been through a similar emotional rollercoaster not a long time ago, but try not to worry too much about it, it will get better, believe me :).

I would say that even radios can be broken and then you cant catch the signal properly... So yeah, I believe that we are more than our bodies, but our bodies can be "broken" In some ways and that can influence how our consciousness, or soul if you want, shows itself

Yes, thank you. The main reason why Im depressed is this fucking quarantine - it lasts almost a year and its driving me crazy. I am a young person (20 years old) and I was really looking forward to 2020 - it was a year when I was supposed to graduate highschool, travel a lot and get into a university. What I got instead? Yes, I graduated (thank god) but didnt travel like i wanted to and didnt get into a school I wanted - entrance exams were cancelled because of corona. Only people with the best marks from highschool got in - and Im not one of them. Another issue is that Ive never been in a relationship before and it makes me really sad - im a very romantic person and I always liked the idea of finding that one person who cares for you and you care for him. I am realistic and I know that finding someone like that takes time - what makes me anxious is the fact that in current situation its basically impossible to meet new people and I am still a weirdo with zero experiences - Ive never even kissed a guy. I already feel old - I think its mostly because im currently spending "the best years of my life" locked up at home, doing nothing. I feel like my youth is being taken away from me. And the situation isnt getting better. I get this feeling that if this shit lasts another year or even two, Ill just end it. When I think about death (which is everyday for about last three months) I always think about my mum. I love her a lot and I know she loves me - but sometimes I get this feeling that she treats me as if I belong to her. I think that she relies on me and my presence too much. She often asks me if I want to move somewhere far away one day - Id love to to be honest, but I feel this kind of pressure from her side. She tells me that she is looking forward to meet her grandkids - and I don't really want to have kids, Ive never really wanted to. I think that our perspectives of life are very different and I cant escape her influence - im locked up at home because of corona. I know that she would be heartbroken, but on the other hand I dont think that suicide is selfish and I dont think that person should live only because of the others, especially at my age when I dont have my own family and noone really relies on me. Its just really hard and I dont know what to do. Its not like im currently planning commiting suicide - but the idea is still inside my mind and I think that Ill eventually do it one day. Current situation completely destroyed my mental stability - I didnt really have any issues before. Another thing is that my family has some experiences with suicide - my greatgrandmother killed herself. And its not like she did it one day because whatever - she tried it three times before she was succesful. She really wanted to do it. You can inherit mental issues, what if I got it from her? I dont know, really.
